children: On September 21, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to not filing its FY 2026 Form 10-K and Q1 FY 2027 Form 10-Q. Netcapital has until October 23, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with a possible exception period through February 9, 2027, and its stock continues to trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under NCPL.
